    if request.headers:
        s += request.headers.to_string() + b'\r\n'

    s += request.body

import unittest

from fb_codemod import utils


class TestUtils(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_get_module_from_path(self):
        module = utils.get_module_from_path('some/path.py')
        self.assertEqual(module,'some.path')

        module = utils.get_module_from_path('some.path')
        self.assertEqual(module,'some.path')

    def test_find_node_by_type(self):
        from ast import Call
        from..test_helpers import parse_ast

        node = parse_ast("""
            a.b.c()
            """)

        self.assertEqual(utils.find_node_by_type(node, Call), node.body[0].value)

    def test_find_node_by_type_invalid_node(self):
        from ast import Call
        from..test_helpers import parse_ast

        node = parse_ast("""
            a.b.c()
            """)

        self.assertIsNone(utils.find_node_by_type(node, Call, True))

    def test_find_node_by_type_invalid_node_raises_error(self):
        from ast import Call
        from..test_helpers import parse_ast

        node = parse_ast("""
            a.b.c()
            """)

        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            utils.find_node_by_type(node, Call, True, RuntimeError)

import unittest
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional

import pytest
from hypothesis import given
from hypothesis import settings as hyp_settings
from hypothesis import strategies as hyp_strats

from..core import _is_builtin_type
from.fixtures import DummyClass
from.utils import (
    assert_raises_hypothesis_given_inputs,
    check_with_different_input_types,
    get_strategies,
    raises_hypothesis_given_inputs,
)


class TestIsBuiltinType:
    @given(
        dummy=get_strategies()["dummy"],
        obj=get_strategies()["object"],
    )
    def test_returns_true_if_object_is_a_builtin_type(self, dummy, obj):
        assert _is_builtin_type(obj)

    @given(
        dummy=get_strategies()["dummy"],
        obj=get_strategies()["object"],
    )
    def test_returns_false_if_object_is_not_a_builtin_type(self, dummy, obj):
        obj = DummyClass()
        assert not _is_builtin_type(obj)
